title: @fal-works/conceptual-model JSON Schema for conceptual class models
description:
Schema for defining conceptual class models that can also be represented as UML class diagrams.
https://github.com/fal-works/conceptual-model

title.description: Title of the conceptual class model

nodes.description: Collection of nodes representing classes, entities, or concepts in the model. Each key is a unique node identifier.

edges.description: List of edges representing relationships, associations, or connections between nodes/classes in the conceptual model

label.description: Display name for this node/class. Can contain \n for line breaks. If omitted, the node key will be used as display name.

source.description: Identifier of the source node/class (must match a key in the nodes object)

target.description: Identifier of the target node/class (must match a key in the nodes object)

relation.description:
Type of relationship/association between the nodes/classes:
- is-composed-of: Composition (ownership with lifecycle dependency)
- aggregates: Aggregation (weak ownership without lifecycle dependency)
- links-to: Simple directed association (reference to the target)
- is-a: Generalization/inheritance

multiplicity.description:
Either:
- Multiplicity on target side (e.g. '1', '0..1', '1..*', '0..*')
- Multiplicity on both sides (e.g. '1 -> *', '0..1 => 0..*')

layout.description: Layout preferences for the diagram rendering.

direction.description:
Direction of the diagram layout:
- TB: Top to bottom layout
- BT: Bottom to top layout
- LR: Left to right layout
- RL: Right to left layout
